description: This PHP source file defines the Controller class for managing PDF configurations within the SuiteCRM Administration module. It extends an abstract controller and provides a method to save settings via POST requests, supporting both AJAX responses and redirects.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Controller class handling PDF configuration save operations within SuiteCRM's administration module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Controller by calling parent constructor with a PDFView instance.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Processes POST data to save PDF engine configuration and responds with JSON if Ajax, otherwise redirects.
